reviews.review: It's a very enjoyable game at it's core, but the optimization really killed it for me. I had fun, and I came back to play more but even playing on the lowest graphics with pretty decent hardware I was getting half second lag spikes every 5 seconds or so. It made it hard to navigate because your character keeps moving with whatever buttons you had pressed at the time, it made it hard to time the reload mechanic because lag spikes would happen before or during the timing where you needed to press the reload key again. It made it frustrating to navigate menus because you'd have to wait for the lag to stop in order to make a selection or see the next screen. Overall, it's got fun gameplay and seems to have decent progression without being absolutely pay to win, but I just can't keep playing more of it because the lag spikes are too bad.

after playing it for an hour i can say this

the game is actually a very good looter shooter roguelike type of game, you choose a character, press start, and you go through waves of enemies until you get to the final boss, characters look badass and amazing, but it has bad optimization, sure it can run on like a 750 ti (which i have) but its a good game even though its free to play.

I tried to like this game. looks cool visually. i'm a huge fan of roguelikes and meta progression. But the characters have poor voice acting and then the stuttering issue is still prevelant. I tried changing every graphic setting known to man, relaunching, graphics driver resets, lowering settings, and even with a 40 series graphics card i'd still stutter. making what could have been an action packed adventure a snail paced slideshow. Its a free game so you have nothing to lose but time if you try it. I'd recommend waiting for a few patches though.
